STAFF REPORT UPDATE (2/5/13): At its regular meeting Monday, February 4,2013, the
City of Cheyenne Planning Commission recommended denial of the Zone Changefrom A-1
(County) to MR-2, Medium-Density Residential ("Developing") by a vote of 3 to 0.The
recommendation was made pursuant to criteria outlined in Section 2.2.1.d of the CheyenneUDC,
based on the issues relating to exclusion of the stormwater detention pondfrom the project,
access from Converse to Ogden, pedestrian connectivity from the subdivision to Anderson
Elementary School, thelarge block size, and issues relating to the open space requirement.
